title: Business Development Intern
description:
**We’re Hiring: Business Development Intern \| Zelandium** 




 Are you curious about how businesses find customers, build partnerships, and grow?
 



 Do you enjoy
 **researching businesses, connecting with people, and identifying new opportunities** 
 ?
 



 If yes, this could be a great opportunity to start your career in
 **Business Development and B2B Sales** 
 .
 



**About Zelandium** 




**Zelandium is an eCommerce technology company helping businesses build, modernize, and scale high\-performance online stores.** 




 We provide end\-to\-end eCommerce technology solutions, including eCommerce development, custom platforms, API and headless commerce, payment and shipping integrations, cloud deployment, performance optimization, analytics, automation, and ongoing technical support.
 



 We work with both
 **B2C and B2B businesses** 
 , helping them launch new digital commerce platforms, modernize existing systems, improve operational efficiency, and scale their online presence.
 



**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a
 **confident, proactive, and business\-minded Business Development Intern** 
 to join our remote team.
 



 You’ll work closely with the
 **sales and marketing teams** 
 to research potential clients, generate leads, identify decision\-makers, conduct outreach, support follow\-ups, and contribute to business growth.
 



 This is a hands\-on role where you’ll get practical exposure to
 **B2B sales, lead generation, prospecting, client communication, market research, and eCommerce technology** 
 .
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Research and identify potential B2B clients, industries, and business opportunities
* Build and maintain targeted prospect lists and lead databases
* Generate leads through
 **LinkedIn, email, online directories, and other digital channels**
* Research companies and understand their business and eCommerce requirements
* Identify relevant decision\-makers and support prospect outreach
* Prepare personalized outreach messages and sales materials
* Communicate professionally with prospective and existing clients
* Conduct follow\-ups and support the sales process
* Track leads, outreach activities, responses, and opportunities
* Research competitors, market trends, and customer requirements
* Coordinate with sales, marketing, and technology teams on qualified leads
* Contribute ideas to improve lead generation and business development processes



**What We're Looking For** 



* Strong
 **verbal and written communication skills**
* Confidence in speaking with people and communicating professionally
* Good understanding or genuine interest in
 **Business Development, B2B Sales, and lead generation**
* Good research and analytical skills
* Ability to research companies and identify potential business opportunities
* Proactive, curious, and growth\-oriented mindset
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a remote environment
* Interest in
 **eCommerce, technology, SaaS, sales, or business development**



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with CRM or lead management tools
* Knowledge of
 **LinkedIn prospecting or email outreach**
* Experience in customer interaction, sales, business development, sponsorship, or similar activities
* Basic understanding of eCommerce platforms or online stores
* Basic understanding of digital marketing
* Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides



**What You'll Gain** 




 Get hands\-on experience in
 **B2B business development and lead generation** 
 , while working closely with sales, marketing, and technology teams.
 



 You’ll develop practical skills in
 **prospecting, outreach, follow\-ups, client communication, market research, and business development** 
 , while gaining exposure to the eCommerce technology industry.
 



 📍
 **Work Mode:** 
 Remote
 



 ⏳
 **Duration:** 
 Up to 6 months
 



 🏆
 **Performance\-based incentives** 




 Whether you're a
 **final\-year student or a recent graduate** 
 , if you're interested in building a career in sales and business development, we'd love to hear from you.
 



 📩
 **To Apply:** 
 Send your CV to
 **career@zelandium.com**

 **Tag them or share this opportunity!**

title: Founding GTM Lead – Overseas Sales
description:
**Company:** 
  Datafuel Labs Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
  Remote/Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
  4–8 years
 



  




 About Datafuel
 
 Datafuel is an AdTech platform that helps e\-commerce brands automate and optimize their performance marketing. We currently work with 200\+ brands and are now looking to expand into international markets.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a hands\-on 
 **Founding GTM Lead** 
  to build our overseas sales function from the ground up.
 



 You will be the first person responsible for establishing this department. You will personally manage the complete sales journey—from identifying prospects and generating leads to cold calling, conducting demos and closing overseas customers.
 



 Once the sales process becomes repeatable, you will help hire, train and manage the GTM team.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Identify the right overseas markets, customer segments and decision\-makers
* Build qualified prospect lists using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo
* Conduct cold calls and reach prospects through email and LinkedIn
* Book and conduct discovery calls and product demonstrations
* Manage follow\-ups, objections, negotiations and deal closures
* Build and maintain the sales pipeline and CRM
* Test different markets, messages and outbound strategies
* Create sales scripts, email sequences, playbooks and reporting systems
* Personally acquire the first set of international customers
* Eventually recruit, train and manage SDRs and sales team members


 Ideal Candidate
 * 4–8 years of B2B sales or GTM experience
* Proven experience selling to the US or other overseas markets
* Experience building outbound pipeline personally
* Strong cold\-calling, cold\-emailing and appointment\-setting skills
* Experience conducting demos and closing deals independently
* Preferably experienced in B2B SaaS, AdTech, MarTech or e\-commerce technology
* Comfortable working as an individual contributor before building a team
* Strong spoken and written English
* Highly self\-driven, resourceful and comfortable building processes from scratch


 What Success Looks Like
 
 In your first few months, you will:
 


* Establish Datafuel’s overseas ideal customer profile
* Launch outbound calling, email and LinkedIn campaigns
* Generate qualified international opportunities
* Personally conduct demos and close initial customers
* Build a repeatable sales process that can be scaled through a team


 Important
 
 This is not a strategy\-only or people\-management position. The person joining must be willing to personally prospect, cold\-call, conduct demos and close deals before building and managing the department.

title: Account Executive
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
 Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy \& Execution
   

  

* Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy tailored to the CAE market, focusing on industries such as automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial equipment, and electronics.
* Identify and prioritize target customers, including OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and R\&D\-driven organizations.

* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing high\-value deals with enterprise clients.

* Maintain accurate records of sales activities, pipeline, and forecasts using CRM tools. Market \& Competitive Analysis
* Monitor CAE industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitors to refine sales strategies.

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Business

* Experience managing complex, technical sales cycles with enterprise customers and engineering teams.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed sales quotas in the engineering software market.
* Strong understanding of CAE workflows, product lifecycle management (PLM), and digital twin technologies.
* Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
* Fluent in English Key Competencies
* Technical acumen: Ability to understand and communicate engineering simulation concepts effectively.
* Customer\-focused approach: Ability to build relationships with engineers, CTOs, and R\&D leaders.
* Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.
* Adaptability in fast\-changing technology landscapes. Location \& Travel
* Hybrid or remote, depending on company policy.
* Willingness to travel (up to 50%) for client meetings, industry events, and technical workshops. We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

title: Business Manager
description:
**Position Summary** 
 :
   

  

  

 The Business Manager is responsible for overseeing the business operations within the assigned region. This role involves managing a team of employees and consultants, achieving profitability goals, and ensuring efficient operations. The Business Manager collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external customers to drive growth, execute strategic plans, and ensure compliance with, LEGAL, regulatory and quality standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales, market development, and key account management, with a focus on driving sustainable, profitable growth. Additional knowledge and experience on product registration will be preferred.
 


  


**Role Responsibilities** 
 :
 


  

  
* Achieve annual profitability goals by managing the regional team, portfolio, and strategy, reflected in the region's P\&L.
  
* Establish annual working plans with internal stakeholders and key customers to capture growth opportunities for products in the region.
  
* Oversee daily operations, including budget management and setting performance objectives for the team.
  
* Design and execute annual product plans and longer\-term projections to meet sales and profit objectives in collaboration with product managers.
  
* Provide input into pricing and sales terms annually, ensuring balance and efficiency in market approach.
  
* Develop and implement business, marketing, and advertising strategies to support regional growth.
  
* Identify and execute distribution changes and optimize the overall go\-to\-market strategy.
  
* Manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders, negotiating contracts and fostering collaboration.
  
* Plan, evaluate, and optimize operational processes to ensure cost\-effectiveness and efficiency.
  
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards for all products and services in the region.
  
* Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual statements, analysis, and reports on operations and financial performance.
  
* Provide input into the annual budgeting process to align with product strategies and regional growth objectives.
  
* Address escalated customer issues, incident reports, and legal matters as necessary.
  
* As the regional Sales \& Marketing Team Leader, ensure quality service by establishing and enforcing organizational standards and compliance.
  
* Developing trial protocols, coordination with the universities and CROs for data generation and knowledge on registration process will be required.
  


  


**Education** 
 :
   

  

  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Agriculture, or a related field.
   

  

  

  • Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is preferred.
 


  


**Experience / Skills / Abilities** 
 :
   

  

  

  • Minimum of 10 \- 15 years of experience in the agrochemical business, with a strong focus on sales, market development, and account management.
   

  

  

 • Proven experience managing key accounts and customers, with a track record of successful contract negotiations, A/R CONTROL and strategic partnerships.
   

  

  

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute business strategies, with a focus on profitability and growth.
   

  

  

  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing employees and consultants.
   

  

  

  • Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in other languages is a plus.
   

  

  

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders.
   

  

  

  • Ability to work collaboratively, manage resources effectively, and ensure maximum return on investment.
   

  

  

  • Experience managing sales teams and organizations is a plus.
   

  

  

  • Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
 


  


**Job Expectations / Working Conditions** 
 :
   

  

  

  • Ability to travel frequently within the assigned region to meet with customers, distributors, and attend industry events.
   

  

  

  • Hybrid/remote working flexibility, depending on the geographic location.
   

  

  

  • Must be able to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment. 
   

  

  

  • Strong commitment to achieving business goals and driving the company’s success in the region.

title: Principal Partner Sales Executive
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global Partners Organization (GPO) builds and grows the partner ecosystem that helps Workday and our customers succeed. We work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Services, Marketing, and Product teams to generate and influence pipeline, prepare partners to deliver great work, and give customers a consistent experience no matter which partner they work with.
   

  

 Joining GPO in India means helping shape a fast\-growing ecosystem from the ground up: you'll work across a diverse set of partners, from global system integrators to emerging AI and value\-added reseller partners, and see the direct impact of your work on Workday's growth in the region.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Principal Partner Sales Executive, you will own execution across a defined portfolio of partners in India. You will manage day\-to\-day partner relationships, run joint go\-to\-market plans, and help partners meet their pipeline and revenue goals. You'll work closely with the India sales team so that partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced opportunities move smoothly from first conversation to close.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Work with partners and the India sales team to build and progress pipeline, and manage partner\-related deals through to close.
* Prepare partner sales teams on Workday's offerings and go\-to\-market approach, and help partners earn and maintain the certifications they need.
* Build and run joint go\-to\-market plans with your partners, including regular business reviews and executive check\-ins to track progress and address risks.
* Identify and onboard new referral, alliance, and global systems integrator partners, as well as AI, Workday GO, FINS, and value\-added reseller partners for the region.
* Connect partner leaders with Workday's Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services teams to build alignment on plans for individual accounts and industries.
* Serve as the main point of contact for your partner portfolio, including for day\-to\-day questions or issues that come up.


**About You**
 Basic Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of relevant experience in technology sales, channel sales, or alliance management, ideally within the SaaS or enterprise software industry.
* Experience managing partner relationships and joint go\-to\-market plans that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.


**Other Qualifications**
* Channel partner management: You've built and managed relationships with partners, including recruiting new partners and helping them grow their practice and delivery quality.
* Deal and pipeline management: You're comfortable managing opportunities from early pipeline through to close, and have a track record of meeting sourcing and influencing targets.
* Go\-to\-market planning: You've built and run joint plans with partners across industries, including business reviews and governance to track progress.
* Relationship building and stakeholder alignment: You connect people across organizations, building trust and alignment between partner and internal teams at all levels, including senior leaders.
* Business development: You've identified and brought on new types of partners (for example, in AI or emerging technology areas) to expand a company's reach into new markets or segments.
* Comfort with data and tools: You're familiar with CRM and partner\-tracking tools (for example, SFDC or Partner Center) and are comfortable using data to prepare partner reviews and guide decisions; experience with Sigma is a plus.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
   

  

 Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
   

  

 If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
